hints.title: Reduction to Non-Adjacent Selections
hints.text: The problem is equivalent to choosing n non-adjacent slices from a circular array of 3n elements to maximize total sum.

hints.title: Break Circularity
hints.text: Because index 0 and index 3n - 1 are adjacent, consider two cases: slices 0 to 3n - 2, or slices 1 to 3n - 1.

hints.title: Two Dimensional State
hints.text: Let state(i, j) be the maximum sum choosing j non-adjacent slices from the first i elements. Transition by taking or skipping element i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice fails because choosing a large slice may force you to skip two even larger neighbors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: House robber variant with k selections over linear arrays of length 3k runs in O(k * (3k)) = O(N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms the game into picking k non-adjacent elements on two linear subarrays.
complexity.notes: Total slices is a multiple of 3.
